mapper.select: SELECT roi.id, roi.return_id, roi.sku_id, roi.sku_code, roi.sku_name, ps.size_value AS size_value, roi.quantity, roi.quality_status, roi.created_at, roi.updated_at FROM return_order_item roi LEFT JOIN product_sku ps ON roi.sku_id = ps.id AND ps.deleted = 0 WHERE roi.return_id = #{returnId} ORDER BY roi.id ASC

SELECT roi.id, roi.return_id, roi.sku_id, roi.sku_code, roi.sku_name, ps.size_value AS size_value, roi.quantity, roi.quality_status, roi.created_at, roi.updated_at FROM return_order_item roi LEFT JOIN product_sku ps ON roi.sku_id = ps.id AND ps.deleted = 0 WHERE roi.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO return_order_item (return_id, sku_id, sku_code, sku_name, quantity) VALUES (#{returnId}, #{skuId}, #{skuCode}, #{skuName}, #{quantity})
